how_it_works.heading: How the game works
how_it_works.illustration_alt: Illustration: a small filled dot with a ring around it, and a pointer inside the ring.

labels.ring: the ring: keep your pointer inside it

how_it_works.text: A dot moves slowly around the box, with a ring around it. Keep your pointer inside the ring as the dot moves. The ring changes colour while you're inside it.
how_it_works.mouse: Mouse or touchpad: just move the pointer; no clicking needed.
how_it_works.keyboard: Keyboard: press Tab to select the box, then move your marker (a small cross) with the arrow keys.

picture.heading: Choose a picture
picture.invitation: Bring to mind a picture of something you feel stuck on or reluctant to start. For example:
examples: starting a task you've been putting off
a part of your learning that feels hard
sitting down and not knowing where to begin
picture.experiment_note: For your experiment, choose something about what you plan to learn today.
picture.safety: Choose an everyday situation, not a painful personal memory. If something painful comes up, stop. You can stop at any time.
picture.field_label: Describe your picture in a few words
picture.field_placeholder: e.g. opening chapter 3 and feeling lost
picture.field_hint: Only you see this, as a reminder during the exercise. It isn't saved.
picture.rating_before: Bring your picture to mind now.
picture.rating_after: Think of your picture once more: “{picture}”.

image_variant.title: Picture it, then follow the dot
image_variant.about_intro: In this exercise you hold a picture in mind while following a moving dot on the screen. There are three parts:
about_parts: Play 8 rounds of 24 seconds, with short pauses, while keeping your picture in mind.
image_variant.about_duration: About 7 minutes. You can stop at any time with “Stop the exercise”.
image_variant.practice: Try it now for 15 seconds. This practice doesn't count, and you don't need your picture yet.
image_variant.hold: Bring your picture to mind: “{picture}”. Hold it for 10 seconds.
image_variant.round: Keep your pointer in the ring, and keep your picture in mind: “{picture}”.
image_variant.rest: Pause. Round {next} of {sets} starts in {seconds} s. Bring your picture back to mind: “{picture}”.

game_only_variant.title: Follow the dot
game_only_variant.about_intro: In this exercise you follow a moving dot on the screen. There are two parts:
about_parts: Play 8 rounds of 24 seconds, with short pauses.
game_only_variant.about_duration: About 6 minutes. You can stop at any time with “Stop the exercise”.
game_only_variant.practice: Try it now for 15 seconds. This practice doesn't count.
game_only_variant.round: Keep your pointer in the ring.
game_only_variant.rest: Pause. Round {next} of {sets} starts in {seconds} s.
